notes.title: Patch 0.758 Quality of Life improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.758 introduces a highly requested quality-of-life feature: [b]Recipe Book[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]One of the most common complaints from players was the recipe limit—only being able to learn up to 3 recipes at once, and having to discard one when exceeding capacity. Losing a hard-earned recipe felt frustrating, and worse, relearning it cost extra money.[/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Recipe Book[/b] solves this frustration. When you learn a recipe for the first time, a Recipe Book of that recipe will be added to your inventory. You can use the Recipe Book to re-learn that recipe at any time, unlimited times. This makes recipes collectible and allows you to freely swap the dishes you can cook.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also added a setting to invert the Y-axis for players who prefer that control style.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other changes, bug fixes, and improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Minor Change:[/b] Removed the Wishlist button for Early Access.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where cooks or servers’ right hands could get stuck in a “carrying plate” position.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Guest orders are now cancelled if the player apologizes for not having the required ingredients.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed interaction tags that could remain on objects after Build Mode and couldn’t be cleared.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where players couldn’t scroll past the first 10 decorations in Orb Mode.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed display issues with existing advertisements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed incorrect contract price display for items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Players can now cook any recipe at any time.[/p][list][*][p]Previously, you could only cook recipes that were on the menu. This was meant to preserve ingredients early on but became restrictive later.[/p][/*][*][p]Instead, you can cook any recipe you know, but cooking is now locked until [b]Day 3[/b], ensuring smooth early-game progression.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Improvement (Settings):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Simplified Game Speed settings to [b]Slow, Normal, Fast[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified V-Sync settings to [b]30, 60, 120, 150 fps[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Invert Y-Axis Control[/b] option.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unintuitive texture quality settings and localization issues.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Customers will no longer be scheduled too late when there are too few of them, reducing unnecessary waiting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Added a tutorial page for [b]Advertisement[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.757 Performance Optimization and bug fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.757 is an important update for [b]Steam Deck players[/b], focusing on performance optimization in [i]Magic Inn[/i]. These improvements should effectively resolve:[/p][olist][*][p]Crashes when visiting the Central Market.[/p][/*][*][p]Crashes when visiting the Crop Market during busy times.[/p][/*][*][p]Crashes when too many customers appear at once.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Tests show:[/p][list][*][p]~15% reduction in CPU and GPU usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Nearly 40% reduction in memory usage when many characters are present in the scene.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additional Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where characters didn’t sit properly on chairs and appeared to float near tables if the player entered Build Mode before opening the inn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit in Build Mode where furniture could be infinitely duplicated by spawning it for placement and then pressing [i]Collect[/i] to cancel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the starting camera angle when entering a new scene, such as the market or the inn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Improvement:[/b] When switching to Orb Mode, the camera now cuts cleanly instead of using a slow transition that could feel dizzying.[/p][/*][/list][p]A huge thank-you to all the players who reported these bugs and for your patience with our buggy little game—I truly appreciate it![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.756: Major Staff AI Fixes and Applying for a loan
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Sorry it took a few days to prepare [b]Patch 0.756[/b]. This update includes major fixes for staff AI and introduces a new feature that lets you apply for a loan from the Central Market at any time.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Staff AI Fixes[/b]
Previously, chefs often prepared customer orders in the wrong priority, which could prevent you from serving customers and risk losing regulars. They would even waste time making orders that had already been cancelled when customers left, and in some cases a bug caused chefs to remake duplicate orders.[/p][p]With this patch, chefs will now:[/p][list][*][p]Prioritize orders based on customer patience.[/p][/*][*][p]Avoid preparing cancelled orders.[/p][/*][*][p]No longer create duplicate orders.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your chefs should now behave more predictably and work efficiently to serve every customer.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Server and Plate Fix[/b]
Previously, if your server picked up a plate while you were using magic to fly it, a race condition could occur—causing the server to carry “air” instead of the plate. This “air” would then occupy space on the table, causing the server to get stuck and making it impossible to serve that customer.[/p][p]With this patch, the game now handles both scenarios correctly—whether you fly the plate first or the server picks it up first. Servers should no longer get stuck.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Feature[/b]
You can now apply for a loan at the Loan Stall in the Central Market at any time. For players struggling with money, this should be a helpful option once you’ve unlocked access to the Central Market.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Additional Fixes and Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Critical Bug Fix:[/b] Interacting with the advertisement in the phone booth and clicking multiple times before the UI transition is complete no longer freezes the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Events are now scheduled even if treated as expired. This fixes issues—especially for players transferring demo save files—where important events expired and blocked story progression.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] A cutting board placed on top of a counter should prevent other items from being placed on that counter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Cooks searching for a counter will now look for the closest empty one available.[/p][/*][/list][p]I apologize for these issues and truly appreciate all of your support! Next, I’ll be focusing on the major performance issues on Steam Deck that are causing crashes in the later stages of the game.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.755 Conversation Card Game Improvement + Controller Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Patch 0.755 focuses on improving the [b]conversation card game[/b], especially the Negotiation game.[/p][p]I know I previously mentioned working on staff AI, but we’ve received a lot of feedback from players that the Negotiation card game felt unfairly difficult, and that the emotion system didn’t seem to matter. Because of this, I’ve shifted priorities to address these issues first.[/p][p]This patch also includes two [b]critical bug fixes[/b] for controller users, as well as adjustments to decoration attributes and prices. Now, higher-attribute items will demand higher prices, and more difficult-to-craft items will reward greater attributes—making it feel more balanced.[/p][p][b]Details of this patch:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Gameplay:[/b] Adjusted the difficulty of the Negotiation Card Game:[/p][list][*][p]Give an extra Negotiate card to the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the confidence required to play the Negotiate card.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the discount amount rival characters can impose.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay:[/b] Reworked how emotions affect the conversation card game. Emotions now have a more meaningful impact, especially in [i]Attraction [/i]topic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay:[/b] Improved the mechanics of the [i]Convince[/i] card. Its effects can now stack, and it will only be consumed when its effects are applied.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Critical Fix:[/b] When selecting a destination to travel to, choosing “No” no longer causes the menu to freeze and force the player to quit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Critical Fix:[/b] During the conversation card game, using the [i]Silence[/i] card and quickly pressing the select button no longer causes a crash that locked player movement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a configuration issue with the walls of the main market shop that caused icons to be hidden.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] In Laurel’s Inn, the player’s bedroom window no longer allows visibility into a guest bedroom.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance:[/b] Adjusted decoration attributes and prices across all items.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.754 More Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I’ve been traveling the past few days and wasn’t able to work on the game, but now I’m back and will be pushing more patches in the near future.[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.754 is primarily a bug-fix update, aimed at making the game more stable and smooth:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Critical Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where, for unknown reasons, guests staying in the inn did not have matching records, causing a game-breaking bug with an empty guest list and no new guests arriving.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Wallpaper “Chocolate” tile was not accessible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where wallpaper changes sometimes wouldn’t save after placement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] During the [i]Build a Mortar[/i] task, players received a Magic Spirit item. This item is now marked as a quest item and cannot be sold; otherwise, players could get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where players could walk into market stalls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed the tutorials for [i]Contract[/i] and [i]Fire Travel[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] At the start of Act 2, talking to Luka now correctly clears his notification.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed camera angles during group dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] After learning a new recipe, players can now use the controller to select a recipe to discard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] The top part of the bar is now transparent when it obstructs the line of sight.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We truly appreciate all the support from the community! We’ll also begin brainstorming new content for Act 2 soon. If you’d like to participate, you’re more than welcome to join our Discord and chat with us directly![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.753 Can't use Recipe Fix
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Unfortunately, my last patch introduced a critical bug that prevented players from learning recipes.[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.753 fixes this issue.[/p][p][/p][p]I’m very sorry for the mistake, and I promise to do better next time by doing more testing, especially on new features before release.[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry again for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.752 Bulk Purchase + Critical Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.752 introduces a new quality-of-life feature: [b]bulk purchasing[/b] in shops.[/p][p][/p][p]Previously, in the shopping menu, each click on an item added only a single unit to the cart. This was tedious if a player wanted to buy larger quantities—like 20 of the same item. With bulk purchase, holding [b]Shift[/b] while clicking will now add [b]10 items[/b] at a time to the cart.[/p][p][/p][p]This patch also fixes two critical bugs:[/p][olist][*][p]When talking with a character, clicking too quickly could cause the conversation to get stuck and the game to freeze.[/p][/*][*][p]When loading a game or starting a new day, the player could get locked in place and had to press extra buttons to regain control.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Finally, a few minor fixes were made for the Simplified Chinese language version:[/p][list][*][p][b]Minor Fix:[/b] Removed incorrect tooltip when opening the map that hinted players could click on it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor Fix:[/b] Localized additional text into Simplified Chinese.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor Fix:[/b] Fixed incorrect control icon display during tutorials in the Simplified Chinese version.[/p][/*][/list][p]More improvements and fixes are coming tomorrow![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.751 Fire Travel Quest Fix
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Today’s patch (0.751) is a small bug-fix update, mainly focused on addressing the issue where players were unable to complete the Fire Travel quest.[/p][p][/p][p]If a player hired a special character too early, it could break story progression, preventing the abandoned inn from appearing on the map. In the last patch, I added a safeguard to stop this from happening. With this patch, the game will now also detect if your save file is already stuck and attempt to repair it automatically.[/p][p][/p][p]This patch also fixes a bug introduced in a recent update where, after upgrading the inn, the task display would error out and fail to show correctly.[/p][p][/p][p]I’ll continue working on reported issues—thank you all so much for your patience and support![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.75 Emergency Fix
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]In the last patch (0.749), I mistakenly carried over the demo’s progression locks into the Early Access version. This prevented many players from advancing the story.[/p][p][/p][p]I sincerely apologize for this mistake and for the frustration it has caused![/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.75 fixes this issue. When you load your save file, the game will automatically detect and remove the locks. Missing events will also be restored so you can continue the story.[/p][p][/p][p]From now on, the Early Access version will also accept save files from the demo. When loading them, the game will remove the demo locks and restore missing events, allowing you to continue seamlessly.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, the game now prevents players from hiring a certain special character too early, as doing so could also block story progression.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience and understanding![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.749 Full Controller Support, Steam Deck Support and Steam Cloud
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]With Patch 0.749, [i]Magic Inn[/i] now has [b]full controller support[/b] and is fully playable on the Steam Deck! In addition, Steam Cloud saves are now supported![/p][p][b]Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players on Steam Deck may experience crashes when visiting the market at night. As a temporary workaround, please go to [b]Settings → Graphics[/b] and turn off [b]Fog[/b]. I’ll continue working on performance optimizations.[/p][/*][*][p]With the current Steam Cloud configuration, different Steam accounts on the same computer will share the same save files.[/p][/*][/list][p]This patch also includes two critical crash fixes—one during inn decoration and another when opening a chest with a controller.[/p][p]Next, I’ll focus on fixing more bugs, including staff AI issues, as well as adding quality-of-life features like manual saves and bulk purchases.[/p][p]In our Discord, players have also provided great feedback on some plot issues, which I’ll be improving soon. More updates are coming, and a huge thanks to our playtesters in Discord for helping us find and report these bugs![/p][p][b]Summary of this patch:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Critical Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a crash when decorating the inn. If a player collected an item attached to another object first, the game would crash when attempting to collect the attached object.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a crash when opening a chest using a controller.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where, after changing screen resolution, the cutting minigame could spawn UI elements in abnormal positions, preventing completion and causing the player to get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] Added the ability to use a controller to select different regions and destinations on the world map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] Players can now use controllers to purchase hiring services.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controls Adjustment:[/b] Simplified entering Build Mode or Magic Mode—now accessible with a single key instead of a key combination.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Simplified Controls:[/b] Removed assigning items to the item wheel. Items can now only be used directly from the inventory menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck Fix:[/b] Balanced the cutting minigame difficulty on Steam Deck, which was previously harder than on PC due to resolution differences.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Added missing icons for certain conversation cards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Small Fix:[/b] The chest under the loan stall is no longer interactable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Small Fix:[/b] Changed the developer command key from [b]F12[/b] to [b]F8[/b] so it no longer conflicts with the screenshot key.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dialogue Fix:[/b] Corrected dialogue with the Caretaker that was mistakenly assigned to the wrong character.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Fix:[/b] Adjusted the location of control mappings in the staff management menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Cloud Support:[/b] Save files are now synced with Steam Cloud.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.748 Controller Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Today’s update focuses mainly on fixes related to controller support. One major feature still missing for controllers is the ability to select a region (such as the Central Valley) during Fire Travel. This will take a bit more time to implement correctly.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, new bugs have been reported. I’ve read through all of them and am actively working on fixes. I know there are still quite a few unresolved issues, and I want to sincerely apologize and thank you for your patience.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, the [i]Magic Inn[/i] Demo has been updated with the latest improvements. However, if you previously played the demo and are now starting the Early Access version, you will unfortunately need to restart. The demo save file still has certain plot and upgrade locks in place. This will be addressed in a future update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes in this patch:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Interaction Fix:[/b] Improved interaction when NPCs are seated—it’s now easier to talk to them from the right side of the table.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interaction Fix:[/b] Adjusted the position of interaction hints for tables and the bartending stand.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] Use the left and right triggers to switch tabs during character customization.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] You can now use the controller to use items in your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] You can now use the controller to click on the world map to enter the outer view.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] Disabled all controller-triggered actions in the guest list, as these features are not yet ready.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] You can now use the controller to accept or reject a contract.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where, during card games with a controller, the game would sometimes incorrectly display topic cards, wasting the player’s turn.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.747 Critical Bug fix
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]The previous patch (0.746) introduced a bug that prevented players from leaving the market or using Fire Travel.[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.747 fixes this issue.[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the inconvenience![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.746 Controls and Interactions Overhaul and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]This patch introduces a major overhaul of the controls and interaction system. As many of you have experienced, interacting with objects in [i]Magic Inn[/i] could feel finicky, unstable, and unpleasant. This update aims to resolve those issues.[/p][p][/p][p]Combined with the previous patch’s camera improvements, the game should now feel smoother, more intuitive to control, and more reliable. It might not be perfect yet, and I will continue refining it. Please let me know if the controls still feel awkward—your feedback would be a tremendous help![/p][p][/p][p]Tomorrow, my focus will finally return to adding Steam Deck support, implementing Steam Cloud saves, and of course, addressing more reported bugs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Summary of Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Completely overhauled the interaction system to replace janky controls and unintuitive object interactions with a smoother, more responsive experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Improvement:[/b] Players can now aim higher with the camera.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] For interactions that require holding a key, the game now displays a “hold” instruction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Cleaning or crafting actions will now automatically stop once completed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Sleeping early no longer causes players to skip important end-of-day events and miss story progression tasks. These events will now be scheduled for the next day.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Sprinting now begins when the Shift key is pressed, not when it is released.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed the functionality of the [i]Convince[/i] card.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where the game would keep swapping control mappings between PC and controller.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.745 Emergency Bug Fix
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]I’ve just realized that my previous control fix accidentally broke Luka’s letter tutorial, which could block many players from progressing. I sincerely apologize for this mistake.[/p][p]This patch addresses the following issues:[/p][list][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Completing Luka’s letter task would prompt the player to press “Ctrl” to collect, but pressing it had no effect.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Occasionally, guests would arrive with an invalid emotion, which could cause the game to crash.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your understanding![/p]

notes.title: Patch Version 0.744 Bug Fixes and Plushies
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Today’s patch is focused mainly on bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]Aside from fixing issues, tomorrow I’ll begin optimizing player interactions with objects and improving controller support. Hopefully, by the end of this weekend, you’ll be able to enjoy a smooth experience on the Steam Deck![/p][p][/p][p][b]Camera Adjustment:[/b] In Build Mode, the camera will now automatically avoid obstacles such as walls and ceilings when placing decorations.[/p][p]
[b]Plushies:[/b] Added adorable plushies to the plushie stall in the market—be sure to check them out![/p][p]
[b]Improvement:[/b] The True North building in the Central Market has received a fresh coat of paint and polish.
[/p][p][b]Balance:[/b] Adjusted the room attributes for the Act 2 Inn.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when the newspaper displayed both a North Star award and an advertisement at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual glitch in Luka’s letter tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where loan interest was being deducted twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Players can no longer sell items when their gold is negative.[/p][/*][*][p]The Magic Stall in the market will no longer spawn, as it’s not ready yet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed room prices stays 0 in the Act 2 Inn’s bedroom even after decoration.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where random chests could spawn in mid-air or on top of characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Pumpkin Lantern could not be picked up after placement.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support![/p]

notes.title: Patch Version 0.743 Rainy Day Task Adjustment and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hi, everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]Today I have to spend a lot of time fixing a single bug, so I couldn't get to the others as much. I'm aware of all of the issues, and I will hopefully make more progress fixing them tomorrow. Here is a summary of this patch:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Task Adjustment:[/b]
Many players reported that the [i]Rainy Day[/i] task could not be completed due to a lack of dirty tables. This task has now been adjusted to only appear on days when it can actually be completed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Tutorial Controller Mapping:[/b] Fixed an issue where, during the tutorial, controller users would sometimes see PC key prompts instead. This could cause players to get stuck if they didn’t have access to a keyboard. The game now detects the next input and updates the control mapping accordingly. However, I'm still looking into why control mapping keep swapping.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magic Orb Mode Camera:[/b] Fixed incorrect camera configuration in Magic Orb mode that caused erratic camera movements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Matilda's Salary:[/b] Players should no longer be able to change Matilda’s salary, as she works for free. She will now be satisfied just like Luka.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.742 Camera Tweaking and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Today was a bit of a slower day for me—I only managed to fix a few urgent issues. That said, I spent time studying how other games handle interactions and came up with a few ideas to improve our system. I’ll start implementing those improvements tomorrow.[/p][p][/p][p]Controller use and Steam Deck play are still not recommended at this time.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the changes included in today’s patch:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added support for controlling the camera with the right joystick on controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled position damping for the camera to make movement feel more responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fix: Samuel should no longer appear at the market stall, and the jeweler's store should now correctly sell relevant decorations.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug Fix: Items behind the bar are now marked as transparent to prevent them from obstructing the view during bartending.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your patience and support![/p]

notes.title: Patch Version 0.741 Camera Improvement and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Thank you so much for your interest in the game and for sharing your reviews and feedback. I’ve read every single one, and I’m actively working to polish and improve the experience.[/p][p]First, I want to apologize for the current state of the controls. I underestimated the importance of user experience, and I’m committed to addressing these issues in the coming days.[/p][p]In this patch, we’ve completely overhauled the camera system. Previously, the camera was unstable, not smooth, and could cause motion sickness. With this update, we hope those concerns are resolved. If you still feel uncomfortable with the camera, please don’t hesitate to let us know![/p][p]Tomorrow, I’ll be focusing on improving responsiveness—especially when it comes to interacting with items, which currently feels unresponsive to many players.[/p][p]I’ll also begin work on full controller support, so you’ll soon be able to enjoy the game on gamepads and the Steam Deck.[/p][p]Thank you again for your patience and support—it truly means a lot![/p][p]This patch also includes a few small bug fixes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Players were unable to collect furniture if the room assignment was incorrect. This restriction has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Corrected the loan contract task title.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where players couldn’t submit loan payments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed the repair sphere task.[/p][/*][*][p]Chinese language now uses a unified font.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release Day!
notes.notes: [p]Hello magic innkeepers,  💕[/p][p][/p][p]The day is finally here, Magic Inn is officially out in Early Access! We’ve been working on this magical journey for the past 4 years, and we’re beyond excited to finally share it with you.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="KvlHMN8UMd4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We apologize that Magic Inn has been delayed two times. We want to take a moment to express our appreciation to everyone who’s been with us patiently. We’re a small team of three people, and this is our very first game. Looking back, we were probably too ambitious to accurately assess our capability.[/p][p][/p][p]To be honest, there're still features we don't have time to add, improve, and polish. But we believe the new journey has just begun and we’ll continue developing the game toward the vision we had when we first started.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Controller Support[/b][/h3][p]Controller support is nearly finished. notes.title: Release Delayed Again
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,  🪄🪄

We’re sorry to announce that the release date for [i]Magic Inn[/i] will be delayed once again.

Since launching [i]Magic Inn: Prologue[/i] and our demo back in February, we've noticed that many players have struggled with aspects of the gameplay, and several bugs have significantly impacted the experience. It's become clear to us that the game needs more time and care to truly fulfill its potential.

Alongside developing exciting new features for Early Access, we've been addressing these issues. However, it causes delays in our planned schedule. This wasn't an easy decision, but we believe it’s necessary for the best possible experience.

Here’s what we’ve been focusing on:

[list]
[*] Enhanced Tutorial: We've completely redesigned the tutorial, incorporating clearer instructions, multi-step tasks, and smoother storytelling to provide seamless onboarding.

[*] Improved User Interface: We've simplified and standardized our UI menus, ensuring a consistent and user-friendly experience throughout the game.

[*] More Magic: We’re significantly expanding our spell collection—though we don’t want to spoil too much!

[*] Expanded Decorations: We've introduced many adorable new decorations, including fresh wallpaper and flooring options. Our build mode has also been enhanced to allow even greater customization flexibility.

[*] Bug Squashing: Naturally, we're tackling all known bugs and any new ones that arise.
[/list]
Our tentative release window is now set for [b]Q2 2025[/b]. However, we want to be fully confident in the game's quality before confirming a final date. We plan to update our demo once we've thoroughly playtested these changes and feel satisfied with the improvements.

Here is a teaser screenshot of our lighting improvements. Hope you all think it looks much better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/ca978916f9952cf47aebde7fe96f90bd707428a5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/e3ba2f1c3acc6efc98d58a35ddd8999ff2484539.png[/img]

We truly appreciate your patience and continued support. 

With love 💖,

Magic Inn Dev Team

notes.title: Release Date is delayed
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 🌟

We’re sorry to announce that we’ve decided to postpone the release date of [i]Magic Inn[/i] to [b]April 2025[/b]. 

As this is our first game, we’ve been a bit too ambitious and lacked experience in setting realistic development goals. Even though we’ve been working tirelessly, we have to remind ourselves that we’re a small team of just four people, with only one programmer. 

[i]Magic Inn[/i] is like our baby. We’ve poured all our love and passion into raising it more than three years from nothing to where it is now. That’s why we don’t want to compromise at the finish line of this long marathon.

We need about three more months to complete one final feature and dedicate a significant amount of time to playtesting. While we can’t promise that every aspect of the gameplay will be perfect for everyone, we’re committed to ensuring a bug-free experience so your time with [i]Magic Inn[/i] is as enjoyable as possible.

Thank you so much for your patience, understanding, and continued support. 💗

With love, 
Magic Inn dev team 🪄🪄

notes.title: Bug Fixes Patch Notes 0.695

Hi, everyone

We are working toward fixing all of the bugs we have found hoping you can have the best experience possible.

[olist]
[*] In build mode, players can now place multiple decorations consecutively.
